pages.text: The $(item)Large Nether Wild Skyseed$() — the same adaptive idea at the bigger tier. It reads the local Nether biome and grows that biome's $(bold)Large$() dedicated isle, so there's room for the odd rare build the small one can't host.
Frame the base Nether Wild in netherrack and nether wart.

Grows the $(bold)_large$() form of whichever Nether isle the biome calls for — a bigger mining rock, a broader fungal forest, a wider soul valley or delta — and, about $(bold)1 in 20$(), a blaze room or a bastion remnant rises with it.
